meta.name: verify-ui-change
meta.description: Check that a change to a web app actually works in the running app before calling it done. Drives the real page and returns a pass/fail verdict with the request that fired, the state that moved, and the file:line to fix. Use after editing a component, a form, a route, or an API call; when you have said "fixed" but have not opened the app; when the user asks "does it actually work?"; or when a change looks right on screen and you cannot prove it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 改完网页代码后驱动真实页面跑一遍,直接给出通过与失败结论。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面却没法证明它真的能跑通。
copy.tagline_en: Drive the real page after a web change and get a clear pass or fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page and can't prove it actually works.

howto.what: 它会在真实运行中的网页里驱动你刚做的改动,然后给出通过/不通过的判定,并附上触发的请求、变化的状态和要修改的 file:line,再报给你。
howto.when: 在你改过组件、表单、路由等之后,或你说了“已修复”却没打开应用,或用户问“真的能用吗”时触发。

say.text: 我刚改完这个表单,帮我在跑着的应用里验证是不是真的生效了
say.note: 它会驱动真实页面,给出通过/不通过的判定

say.text: 这个改动看着没问题,提交前跑一下 coverage,看还有哪些控件没被点到
上次那个点击没反应,重新断言一次,别重放操作
say.note: 它用 since 重新断言,不重复副作用

howto.what_en: It drives the real running web app to check whether your change actually works, then returns a pass/fail verdict with the request that fired, the state that moved, and the file:line to fix.
howto.when_en: Fires after you edit a component, form, or route, when you have said "fixed" without opening the app, or when the user asks whether a change really works.

say_en.text: I just changed this form — verify it actually works in the running app
say_en.note: It drives the real page and gives a pass/fail verdict

say_en.text: This looks fine; run coverage before I commit to see what's untouched
That click did nothing last time — re-assert instead of re-driving it
say_en.note: It re-asserts with since, no repeated side effect
